value.rationale: This is a natural smallest prime-order Paley example with clique number five, with an unexpected sharp threshold from no possible one-jump moves to universal two-vertex mobility. The result identifies the full optimal-solution space with a Frobenius affine Cayley graph, eight generators and exact four-move diameter, a nontrivial structural rather than arbitrary statistic. Established clique-size knowledge is expressly excluded from the novelty claim.
